gen-fs-rajdhani-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded reads as a serif with every letter floating on its own, wiry and open. Rajdhani's dense, uniform strokes then sit above it, so the modern heading tightens up what the body spreads out.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-bitter: Bitter has an oversized lowercase and an s you can see right through, which makes it feel sturdy and dependable. Red Hat Display, drawn like a technical pen, earns its place when set big and brief.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-epunda-slab: Red Hat Display draws everything in a marker-like line of constant width, with daylight inside every curve. Epunda Slab, a text serif with a gaping c, gives it a dignified foil.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-esteban: Refined and classic, Esteban is a text serif whose lowercase looks oversized beside its own capitals. Red Hat Display holds one unbroken line weight throughout, while Esteban's heavier verticals recall a gently tilted nib.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-fauna-one: Red Hat Display holds a single marker-like line width, with visible daylight inside each curve, and it feels bold and contemporary. Fauna One's tall middle band adds a literary, dignified tone.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-faustina: Faustina reads as an authoritative serif, its bowls thinning gently and its c opening like a pair of pliers. Red Hat Display's steady marker line is the sharper partner, and the two differ most in lowercase height.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-glegoo: Glegoo is a refined, editorial serif with big counters and curved letters whose mouths stay wide and unclosed. Make Red Hat Display small and its bold marker line loses its punch.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-halant: Red Hat Display keeps curves and stems in lockstep, a marker-like line with daylight inside every curve. Halant, a text serif, adds a faint thick-thin shift and a towering x-height.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-hanuman: High-waisted and traditional, Hanuman sits under Red Hat Display's bold marker line with wide-set terminals on its s. Its refined serif texture would carry a long page without tiring.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-hedvig-letters: Red Hat Display's round letters have walls as heavy as its straight ones, giving a bold, contemporary marker line. Hedvig Letters Serif, a text serif, does the quieter work, with subtle etched-glass contrast and sturdy, open curves.
